controller: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
reward: terminal target-seat chip delta / active hand big blind; zero at intermediate target decisions
segmentRule: Restart from the exact optimizer-bearing 100,000-hand checkpoint for four isolated 5,000-hand segments, runs 21-24. The paired development diagnosis found no benefit from the prior 100,000-hand extension with Pro imitation on every RL hand. This separate curriculum uses 250 Pro bootstrap hands, 250 imitation steps and one Pro anchor per ten RL hands in each segment. New seed windows are disjoint from all recorded D03 training/evaluation sessions at freeze time. Audit every segment before the next GO; stop on safety, resource or provenance failure. Training is not strength proof.
dataBoundary: Training seeds and all previous H33b or Phase 1 diagnostic seeds are excluded from future candidate final evaluation. Pro anchor uses only actor observation and legal mask; scripted opponent profile is not an input.
publication: No public model, registry, release or Iron adoption from this plan. Independent final 40-cell session evaluation, unknown opponents, human review and Company OS gate are separate.
